I received a free stick of ROC's Hydration+ Replumping Serum Stick in exchange for my honest review. The fact that I can throw this in my bag and easily apply it as needed (throughout the day, on a flight, etc.) is greatly appreciated. The formulation is lightly scented, has a beautiful milky, light blue color and easily glides across the skin - the fact that I could apply a deeply hydrating serum without getting my fingers covered in product is *chef's kiss*. While I didn't notice significant plumping of my fine lines, I really enjoyed the rich hydration it imparted - just note that it leaves a slightly tacky residue. The packaging is great - the outer packaging is lightweight, durable, and aesthetic. The lid securely twists on and it has a domed air-tight inner plastic cap. While I received this stick for free, I plan to purchase another one when I finish this one.
